text.aria-label: Title text 'Where the symmetric path falls for 8 weeks or more, the post hoc path often holds its level'
text.tspan: Where the symmetric path falls for 8 weeks or more, the post hoc path often

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Fitted weekly capacity in MW before the recovery-ratio correction, observed weeks only. Blue: post hoc asymmetric fit (a=2, r=10). Purple: symmetric fit with the same a. Orange shading: a run of 8 or more weeks in which the symmetric path is 10% or more below its own trailing 26-week maximum and the post hoc path is not (a held fall). A held fall is not a real fall, so check each shaded run against the switching log.'
text.tspan: Fitted weekly capacity in MW before the recovery-ratio correction, observed weeks only.
Blue: post hoc asymmetric fit (a=2, r=10). Purple: symmetric fit with the same a. Orange
shading: a run of 8 or more weeks in which the symmetric path is 10% or more below its own
trailing 26-week maximum and the post hoc path is not (a held fall). A held fall is not a
real fall, so check each shaded run against the switching log.
